answer.rationale: Finance’s 18 % cut is non-negotiable and the incumbent has refused to move, so renewal or further negotiation with the incumbent cannot meet the mandate. Deferring or adding a second source would leave the primary contract lapse in 14 days and fail to lock in the required price. Switching the primary supply to the low-cost vendor is the only option that satisfies the cost target, but the assembly line’s 94 % utilization with no buffer makes delivery risk acute. memory_c2 records a prior successful switch to this same low-cost vendor with quick onboarding and accurate invoicing, yet we must verify that record before committing, because any disruption at near-full capacity would be catastrophic. Therefore the action is flagged as high downstream value risk and uncertainty is preserved until the archive is reviewed.
